correctness.rationale: From the actual type-C root product for fundamental weight ω_k, multiplying all non-Levi positive-root contributions gives the stated factorial degree. Legendre v2(m!)=m−s₂(m) and s₂(2j+1)=s₂(j)+1 yield the complete formula for 1≤k≤n. Independently recomputed exact factorial degrees and valuations for every 55 pairs 1≤k≤n≤10; boundaries k=1,2,n checked. Finite checks do not prove the unrestricted claim; explicit root product and identities do.
